youtube.aciklama: An active middle ear implant delivers the amplified signal not into the ear canal but as vibration to the ossicular chain or to one of the inner ear windows. In totally implantable systems, all parts are under the skin; nothing is visible from outside and the system can be used all day, even during sleep and in water, while the battery, depending on the system, is charged from outside or replaced every few years with minor surgery.
